sourceText:
Howdy guys, it's Hoony, I have returned. Unfortunately... We need to test you guys on some things, after some issues that occurred yesterday... I'm sure you can understand.

For now, let's start with a simple language test to get comfortable, could one of you draw up a short quiz, with 10 different languages on it? Preferably different scripts and typefaces, I'm practicing my ability to spot all languages on sight alone, so please don't make it too easy. (:

create an introduction for a blog about "Local Falcon vs Local Viking: Best Tool for Local Visibility". Use the keyword "Local Falcon vs Local Viking" in the first or second line. Start with an engaging sentence addressing the readers' main pain points. 

Argue why the topic is relevant. Make it engaging, attention-grabbing. The last sentence should be calling the reader to read the content, telling what we are going to present, make fluid and humanly, don't make analogies, make around 170 words, don't use "—".

We sent this message to users " According to our records, you are currently running Windows 10.

Windows 10 is reaching end of support soon. This means that the computer may be blocked from the network without notice. We have created this ticket to assess and upgrade the operating system to Windows 11 Pro version." I need to follow up. The user did not respond. I need a follow up message with urgency that prompts them to want to create a time and date to upgrade when they have a few hours open on their calendar.

I am writing an end of year review email for a student. Below is the emails sent throughout the academic year. Summarise using the following key headings: Key Areas of Growth; 5 items
Achievements and Celebrations; 5
Challenges, Development and Progress; 3
Areas of Improvement; 5
Future development; 3

The total length of the content that I want to send you is too large to send in only one piece.
        
For sending you that content, I will follow this rule:
        
[START PART 1/10]
this is the content of the part 1 out of 10 in total
[END PART 1/10]
        
Then you just answer: "Received part 1/10"
        
And when I tell you "ALL PARTS SENT", then you can continue processing the data and answering my requests.

You are a visual analysis expert trained to help me beat the Swamp Frog game on 1xBet. I will upload a screenshot from the game, and your job is to examine it and tell me which direction (Left, Middle, or Right) is safest for the frog to jump next.

Game Rules:
	•	The frog must jump from one platform to another.
	•	Some platforms are safe, others will make me lose.
	•	I want to avoid the bad ones and keep jumping forward.
	•	Visual clues like brightness, glow, texture, shadow, or color might help you spot the safest path.

Your Response Format (only):

🐸 Recommended: Jump [Left / Middle / Right]
✅ Confidence: [percentage]%
🧠 Lucky says: “[short phrase under 10 words]”

Don’t explain your reasoning. Just give your best guess fast so I can keep playing.
